Comment.value: DM-issued token consumed at a Lightsaber Workbench. Cursed + plot so it cannot be traded, stored, sold, or dropped.

value.0:
A rare kyber crystal attuned to its bearer, issued in recognition of their journey toward constructing a lightsaber.

Use this item to attune the crystal, adding one Kyber Token to your currencies. Then visit a Lightsaber Workbench to construct a lightsaber or saberstaff. Workbenches are known to exist at the Sith Academy on Korriban, the Jedi Enclave on Dantooine, and - so the rumors say - somewhere within a hidden cave on Dathomir.

One Kyber Token is consumed when the weapon is constructed. This item cannot be traded, sold, stored, or dropped.
